name: Online Co-op
author: Jeffiest
description: Play Dark Cloud together online, up to four. The host plays their own save and opens a room; friends join it from the title screen's Online Co-op with its code and walk into the host's world: the host's story, towns, Georama and dungeons, with their own weapons, items and Gilda, which the host's save keeps for them. A friend's own save is never touched. Needs the MoonFactory engine with online play (net.*) and visits.
